responsibility: This module contains GCC’s build-time generator toolchain that turns declarative compiler metadata into generated headers, tables, and source used by the rest of the compiler. A large part of the module reads target machine descriptions through the shared read-md and gensupport infrastructure, then generates the core RTL target interfaces: instruction codes, recognizers, operand extractors, emitters, predicates and constraints, output tables, peephole and split logic, optab mappings, target hook wrappers, and target scheduling/attribute machinery including DFA automata, delay-slot handling, and insn attribute evaluators. It also includes generators for other compiler-wide derived interfaces such as machine modes, RTL constructors, tree check macros, combined-function macro families, pass-pipeline instance numbering, target hook boilerplate, version/checksum metadata, and match.pd-based simplifiers for GENERIC/GIMPLE, plus gengtype for emitting GC and PCH support from GTY annotations. Overall, this module is the compiler’s code-generation support subsystem for constructing stable internal APIs and tables from .md files, definition files, and annotated source descriptions before the main compiler is built.
